messages:
emma: Observability alert: bom1 region health checks dropped to 0% ~2m ago, multiple control-plane pods unreachable. hb:region-health triggered. @raj @cory can you triage?
raj: I'm on it. hitting api server times out from control-plane nodes. trying `kubectl --context=bom1 get nodes` now.
cory: seeing kubelet flaps on gpu nodes, many NotReady. past 10m we've got pod eviction loops. dump coming.
sre-bot: Automated incident opened: INC-2026-045. Pager notified ops-oncall.
raj: paste: ```
NAME               STATUS     ROLES    AGE   VERSION
node-bom1-gpu-01   NotReady   gpu      12d   v1.26.4
node-bom1-gpu-02   NotReady   gpu      8d    v1.26.4
node-bom1-mgr-01   NotReady   control  45d   v1.26.4
```
raj: `journalctl -u kubelet` shows repeated `NetworkPlugin cni failed` errors, then `/var/lib/kubelet/pods: transport endpoint not connected`.
cory: +1 on CNI. I can repro `iptables-save` returning corrupt table on a couple hosts. suspect a kernel upgrade or driver oom. no scheduled maints.
toni: Ops suggestion: start redispatch plan A — shift new request routing away from bom1 at the edge LB, fail traffic into blr1 and hyd1. Can we do weighted reroute 90/10 in 5m windows? @ops-oncall please start.
ops-oncall: Kicking off edge config roll: `traffic-shift --from=bom1 --to=blr1,hyd1 --weight=90 --step=5m` running now. will monitor 2xx rates and token latency.
anne: Heads up on cost: hot-shifting to spare GPUs in blr1/hyd1 will spin up 40 p3-like instances. Estimated incremental infra spend ~ $11k/day while hot. We should consider autoscale cap to 30 instances and accept small queueing.
emma: Good call. Prioritize reliability over cost for next 4 hours. Open a billing flag for finance.
raj: I've isolated a bad CNI release on 3 hosts and rolled back to v1.5.2 on those; node conditions starting to recover for 2 hosts.
cory: Rolling kube-proxy restart cluster-wide isn't safe. prefer gradual node restarts after CNI rollback.
ops-oncall: Edge shift at 90% complete. Error rate steady but token latencies up ~120ms. No customer-facing alerts yet.
emma: Escalating to infra lead @anne and platform-eng for postmortem. Add runbook steps: check CNI package, kernel modules, and vendor NIC firmware.
anne: Creating follow-up ticket INF-3229 to track root cause, capacity plan, and cost approvals. tagging Dedicated accounts that may be affected.
emma: Thanks team. Keep updates here every 10m until stable. :thumbsup:
